title: This Spider Weighs as Much as a Baseball and Has a Foot-Wide Leg Span

scenes.text: This spider weighs as much as a baseball.
The goliath birdeater can weigh six ounces.
Its legs can span nearly a foot.
It hunts with fangs about three quarters of an inch long.
Despite the name, it mostly eats earthworms and other small animals, and rarely birds.
If it's scared, it flicks tiny barbed hairs off its body. They itch like crazy.

description:
The goliath birdeater is the heaviest spider on Earth, up to six ounces.
Its legs span nearly a foot and its fangs are about three quarters of an inch long.
Would you hold one?
thumbnail_text: A SPIDER AS HEAVY AS A BASEBALL
